content_preview_500: What are false positive and false negative results? Tests results are usually accurate, but no test is perfect. A false positive result means your test shows you have a disease or condition, but you don't really have it. content_preview_500: What if I do a home test? At-home test kits are available for many types of lab tests. Ask your provider or pharmacist to recommend a test you can trust. And talk with your provider about your results, even if they're normal.
